subject.title: refactor: replace hardcoded ~/.openclaw paths with resolveStateDir()

question: Should existing LanceDB and Memory Wiki stores be automatically migrated by each plugin's doctor contract when `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` begins governing their defaults, or should maintainers adopt and document a different explicit upgrade path?
rationale: The repository policy requires persistent user-state migration to have one owner and rejects steady-state fallback readers; choosing automatic migration versus an explicit operator path is a product and upgrade-contract decision.

options.title: Add plugin doctor migrations
options.body: Implement each plugin's idempotent doctor migration for the old hardcoded store, with upgrade tests and live before/after proof.

options.title: Choose an explicit operator migration
options.body: Document and surface a deliberate migration command only if maintainers do not want doctor to move these stores automatically.

recommendation.title: Add plugin doctor migrations
recommendation.body: Implement each plugin's idempotent doctor migration for the old hardcoded store, with upgrade tests and live before/after proof.
